text_en: Soldier, don't tell me you're late for training.
I just gave the speech to the others and thought that I could finally get back to reading these huge tomes.
Alright, alright. I'll give you a summary, but you will need to focus. I suppose my reading will have to wait.
As you will have noticed, this world is rich in all kinds of materials, beings and other types of magical elements.
General Brigard has allowed me to put all this knowledge to use so that we may better support our ranks.
So I have permission to treat you all like my guinea pigs. Heh, heh, heh.
Apparently this world hosts little creatures known as <color=OBJ>Bygul</color>.
Generally, they are nothing special, but these writings talk of a bygul variant with a radiant green hue.
These are the ones that interest us. In theory, their healing abilities could be of great use.
So keep an eye out on missions and bring them here if you find any.
I think that, for our first experiment, <color=OBJ>fifteen Radiant Bygul</color> will do.
Is that clear? I thought so.
Return when you've found what we need. Now, I would appreciate some silence. This is a library, after all.
